planets.name: WASP-36 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-36 with a 1.54-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: WASP-36 b was found in 2011 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-36. Its orbit and size follow Mancini et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname MANCINI_ET_AL__2016): disc_year 2011, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.537365606, pl_radj 1.327, pl_bmassj 2.361
